title: Learning music: teachers in the band, and string instruments by ear
summary: The band carried a teacher, and he learned strings by ear before learning notes on brass.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: When you learned music, did you have a teacher right away to teach you to read music?

Oh yeah, we always carried a teacher with us, you see. One of the clarinet players was a teacher or a cornet player, you see. Now Pope was the leader, but he wasn't a teacher. A trainer, we had a fellow named Training. This fellow I'm training about in California, his cousin, his cousin was a teacher.
I was going to ask, when you first started on the string instruments, mandolin and the other instruments, guitar, did you have a teacher pick that up yourself?

No, no, I guess I'll pick it up by a year. And I played it pretty well, you see. Figured I used to make right smaller chains and such as that before I started with notes. But when I picked up the brass music, then I started with notes, you see.
